summary: Verified all 8 bug fixes for iteration 7. Backend: 11/11 pytest tests pass against live URL (3 initial 502s were transient Cloudflare/Gemini rate limiting, all passed on serial retry). Verified /api/ai/task and /api/ai/sort now enforce is_clean_task server-side (<=6 words, <=60 chars, no filler prefix). Frontend: code review confirms SpeakScreen always renders 'Speak your chaos' above mic with errors rendered separately as testID='speak-error'; CardScreen groups NOW/LATER blocks (visibleNow.slice(0,4), remainingBudget, visibleLater), drops counted in +N more, research note reads exactly '23 min per interruption — UC Irvine'; resetToSpeak clears card/task/interruptions/draft/plannedSeconds/remaining/error and wired to <Pressable testID='new-session-button'>'New session'; finishSession builds fresh nextCard with current interruptions; startSession clears interruptions. Live smoke on public URL confirmed 'Speak your chaos' visible on first load and no speak-error element rendered without an error.

minor.issue: Cloudflare 502 Bad Gateway occurs intermittently when 2+ Gemini requests run in parallel via pytest-xdist. Individual retries pass. Consider rate-limit-friendly retries or lower xdist concurrency in CI.
